question: What are the most influential papers on metagenomic sequencing? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers on metagenomic sequencing, based on citation counts, include foundational tools for community sequencing analysis like QIIME, genome assembly algorithms such as SPAdes, and key studies on the human microbiome and microbial gene catalogues.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1038/nmeth.f.303","title":"QIIME allows analysis of high-throughput community sequencing data","citation_count":30923},{"doi":"10.1089/cmb.2012.0021","title":"SPAdes: A New Genome Assembly Algorithm and Its Applications to Single-Cell Sequencing","citation_count":23114},{"doi":"10.7287/peerj.preprints.554v1","title":"CheckM: assessing the quality of microbial genomes recovered from isolates, single cells, and metagenomes","citation_count":10938},{"doi":"10.1038/nature11234","title":"Structure, function and diversity of the healthy human microbiome","citation_count":10343},{"doi":"10.1038/nature08821","title":"A human gut microbial gene catalogue established by metagenomic sequencing","citation_count":10031}]}

parsed.answer: The most influential papers on metagenomic sequencing, based on citation counts, include foundational tools for community sequencing analysis like QIIME, genome assembly algorithms such as SPAdes, and key studies on the human microbiome and microbial gene catalogues.
